metric_definitions.action_prevention_recall: Fraction of true-affected actions that were blocked.
metric_definitions.false_block_rate: Fraction of predicted blocked actions that are not in the true-affected set.
metric_definitions.hidden_detection_recall: Predicted node ids vs nodes reachable only via hidden edges. Full-declared scores 1 by selecting every declared node (trivial_full_selection).
metric_definitions.incorrect_action_rate: Trial-level 1 if any true-affected action was not blocked.
metric_definitions.registered_impact_recall: Predicted node ids vs declared-graph affected set only.
metric_definitions.trivial_full_selection: 1 when the strategy selected every declared decision and action.
metric_definitions.true_impact_recall: Predicted node ids vs true-graph affected set (declared ∪ hidden). Vacuous when the truth set is empty.

notes: Database overhead is not applicable: this benchmark is in-process graph analysis.
Model API cost is unknown: no LLM calls are made.
CPU time is not sampled; latency is wall-clock Instant.

limitations: Ground truth includes hidden edges withheld from A–E. STRICT_CONTRACT may block additional actions only when a developer-declared coverage item matches a changed resource.
Full-declared true-impact recall of 1.0 is trivial_full_selection: hidden edges land on existing declared node ids.
No strategy infers unregistered dependencies. STRICT cannot either, unless the contract lists the resource.
A–D outputs are unchanged from v0.3.1; only metric labels and E/F policies were added.
Approval/external delays are metadata. Database overhead N/A. Model cost unknown.
Latency is in-process wall-clock of the strategy function, not end-to-end agent runtime.
